item.title: Nvidia Is Not a Normal Company Having a CEO Issue: Everson
item.description: Carolyn Everson, a board member at Coca-Cola, Disney and Under Armour and a senior advisor at Permira, discusses how boards respond to allegations involving executives. Everson speaks with Romaine Bostick and Jess Menton on “The Close.” (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Charles Elson on Nvidia’s Corporate Governance Structure
item.description: Charles Elson, founding director of the University of Delaware’s Weinberg Center for Corporate Governance, says Nvidia’s board should have had a clearer succession plan and stronger oversight in place. He speaks with Romaine Bostick and Jess Menton on “The Close.” (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Trading Firm IMC Plans to Double Staff in Hong Kong
item.description: IMC Trading expects to roughly double headcount in its Hong Kong office over the next two years, the latest sign of a rush among foreign firms to expand in the city.

item.title: China Internet Stock Gains Face Reality Check in Nvidia Fallout
item.description: A November rebound in beaten-down Chinese internet stocks is facing a reckoning in collateral damage from the scandal at Nvidia Corp.

item.title: Jensen Is Not the Only Executive To Have a Relationship With a Spy: Nell Minow
item.description: Nell Minow, Chair at ValueEdge Advisors, says she was surprised that Nvidia lacked an independent board chair and a formal succession plan. She discusses the allegations regarding Jensen Huang in an interview with Romaine Bostick and Jess Menton on “The Close.” (Source: Bloomberg)
